text:
Saw Karpathy's HackerTube, and roansh's HackerBooks and I've been listening to podcasts while driving which has been quite fun.

HackerCast has 1,157 podcasts you can play, recommended 12,361 times on Hacker News by 7,351 different HN users.

Made with claude Opus 5.5 (medium), Claude wrote all of it and deployed on Cloudflare. I just bought the domain. Purely static site.

Let me know if anyone there are any suggestions/comments. Let me know if there are any other sources from where I can source different kind of good quality podcasts.
title: Show HN: Hackercasts – Podcasts Mentioned on HN
